items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition; Han lexicographic form as transmitted, digitally redrawn in 2017
items.caption: A modern digital redraw of 過 in the seal-script style associated with Shuowen, whose received entry analyzes the graph as 辵 plus phonetic 咼.
items.alt: Black seal-style 過 glyph on a plain background; digital redraw, not an artifact photograph.
items.selection_reason: Shows the received Shuowen-era form relevant to the documented 辵 + 咼 analysis. Commons identifies Sinica Database as one source and states CC0 1.0/public-domain reuse.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain as stated on the Commons file page.

limitations.text: The candidate image is a modern vector redraw in a historical style, not a photograph or facsimile of an excavated artifact; the web tool did not expose its pixel contents for visual inspection.
No early oracle-bone or bronze candidate is included because no relevant primary artifact image and provenance could be verified in the inspected pages.
